description: AI-to-AI 실패 학습 캐시 DB. 불합격 이미지 교정 시 효과가 검증된 영문 프롬프트 패치(Delta)를 누적 저장하여 동일 실패 재발과 토큰 소모를 줄인다.

fabric_texture.label: [최우선 1순위] 옷의 직물 텍스처/원단 조직 미구현
fabric_texture.add_prompt: PRIORITY 1: ultra-faithful micro-level fabric texture and weave structure matching Image 2 hanger shot; crisp visible yarn grain, natural matte weave, authentic fiber thickness and soft raking side light that makes the exact textile surface clearly readable; zero smooth plastic or painted-on cloth
fabric_texture.add_negative: flat textureless fabric, plastic sheen, synthetic smooth cloth, painted-on garment, blurry fabric weave, AI-smoothed textile

horizon_line.label: 배경 수평선/바닥 경계선 노출
horizon_line.add_prompt: a true seamless infinity-cove studio where the plain even medium-light gray backdrop curves smoothly into the floor with NO visible horizon line, NO floor edge, NO baseboard band and NO dark vignette; wall and floor are one continuous smooth gray tone
horizon_line.add_negative: horizon line, floor edge, baseboard, seam, wall-floor boundary, dark vignette

nose_visible.label: 여성 모델 눈/코/이마 노출 (윗입술 크롭 위반)
nose_visible.add_prompt: strictly cropped at the upper lip line; ONLY the lips, chin, neck and body down to the knees are visible inside the frame; zero eyes, zero nose, zero nostrils, zero forehead
nose_visible.add_negative: visible nose, visible nostrils, visible eyes, forehead, full face, uncropped head

floating_hair.label: 중력 무시 / 뜨는 머리카락
floating_hair.add_prompt: strict gravity-bound indoor studio space; hair hangs straight down with real physical weight against the neck and shoulders, zero floating strands, zero wind, zero levitating flyaways
floating_hair.add_negative: floating hair, windblown hair, levitating strands, anti-gravity hair, unnatural volume

sleeve_mismatch.label: 소매 길이 사이즈표 불일치
sleeve_mismatch.add_prompt: enforce exact garment sleeve length from size chart relative to model arm proportion; cuff end must sit precisely at the specified wrist/hand landmark with natural fabric drape
sleeve_mismatch.add_negative: too short sleeves, rolled-up sleeves, oversized dangling sleeves

hem_mismatch.label: 총장/밑단 위치 사이즈표 불일치
hem_mismatch.add_prompt: enforce exact garment body length from size chart relative to model height; hem line must align precisely at the specified hip/thigh/knee landmark
hem_mismatch.add_negative: cropped hem, overly long hem, tucked-in hem unless specified

noise_or_haze.label: 필름 그레인·먼지·흐림·잔상 발생
noise_or_haze.add_prompt: extremely clean high-resolution studio photograph, tack-sharp focus edge to edge (f/5.6-f/8), crisp fabric weave, zero film grain, zero dust specks, zero smudges, zero haze or ghosting
noise_or_haze.add_negative: film grain, noise, dust, smudges, haze, soft focus, motion blur, ghosting, double edges

sleeve_cuff_tab.label: 소매 끝자락 커프 탭/단추 디테일 미구현
sleeve_cuff_tab.add_prompt: MANDATORY CUFF DETAIL: reproduce the exact rectangular fabric sleeve cuff tabs with button near both wrist hems exactly as shown in Image 2; keep both cuffs clearly visible and crisp with clean hand-stitched tab edges
sleeve_cuff_tab.add_negative: plain blank cuffs, missing sleeve tabs, smooth featureless sleeve ends, hidden wrists
